source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Keeps the historical analogy, concealed teaching and purchased-by-Master claim.
verses.before: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.after: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as false teachers will arise among you. They will secretly introduce destructive teachings, even denying the Master who bought them, and bring swift destruction on themselves.
verses.tsw_comparator: But false prophets also arose among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.

verses.rationale: Retains the public consequence of their conduct for the named way.
verses.before: And many will follow their sensuality, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed.
verses.after: Many will follow their shameless conduct, and because of them the way of truth will be slandered.
verses.tsw_comparator: And many will follow their sensuality, and because of them the way of truth will be blasphemed.

verses.rationale: Keeps commerce/exploitation and the personified vigilance of judgment.
verses.before: And in their greed they will exploit you with false words. Their condemnation from long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.
verses.after: In their greed they will exploit you with fabricated stories. Their condemnation, pronounced long ago, is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.
verses.tsw_comparator: And in their greed they will exploit you with false words. Their condemnation from long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.

verses.rationale: Preserves the conditional argument and the pinned chains reading with Tartarus explained in a note.
verses.before: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into Tartarus and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness to be kept until judgment,
verses.after: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into Tartarus and handed them over to chains of darkness, held for judgment;
verses.tsw_comparator: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but cast them into Tartarus and committed them to chains of gloomy darkness to be kept until judgment,

verses.rationale: Unpacks eighth Noah as eight survivors and keeps herald and flood.
verses.before: if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly,
verses.after: if he did not spare the ancient world, but protected Noah, a herald of righteousness, along with seven others, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly;
verses.tsw_comparator: if he did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, with seven others, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly,

verses.rationale: Retains named cities, ashes and exemplary judgment.
verses.before: if by turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes he condemned them to extinction, making them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly,
verses.after: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ruin, reducing them to ashes and making them an example of what awaits the ungodly;
verses.tsw_comparator: if by turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes he condemned them to extinction, making them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly,

verses.rationale: Maintains the surprising righteous description and links rescue to the conditional chain.
verses.before: and if he rescued righteous Lot, distressed by the sensual conduct of the lawless
verses.after: and if he rescued righteous Lot, worn down by the lawless people's shameless way of life—
verses.tsw_comparator: and if he rescued righteous Lot, distressed by the sensual conduct of the lawless

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated righteousness and the daily seeing/hearing burden.
verses.before: (for as that righteous man lived among them day after day, he was tormenting his righteous soul over their lawless deeds that he saw and heard),
verses.after: for that righteous man, living among them, tormented his righteous soul day after day with the lawless deeds he saw and heard—
verses.tsw_comparator: (for as that righteous man lived among them day after day, he was tormenting his righteous soul over their lawless deeds that he saw and heard),

verses.rationale: Supplies the English then to close the long conditional while preserving present punishment.
verses.before: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
verses.after: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trial and to hold the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,
verses.tsw_comparator: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment,

verses.rationale: Keeps flesh, lordship and unnamed glorious beings rather than inventing identities.
verses.before: and especially people who indulge in the desire of defiling passion and despise authority. Bold and willful, they do not tremble as they slander glorious ones,
verses.after: especially those who follow the flesh in defiling desire and despise lordship. Bold and self-willed, they do not tremble at slandering glorious beings,
verses.tsw_comparator: and especially those who indulge in the desire of defiling passion and despise authority. Bold and willful, they do not tremble as they slander glorious ones,

verses.rationale: Preserves the comparison and follows the shorter pinned reading without before the Lord.
verses.before: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, do not bring a reviling judgment against them before the Lord.
verses.after: whereas angels, greater in strength and power, do not bring a slanderous judgment against them.
verses.tsw_comparator: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, do not bring a reviling judgment against them before the Lord.

verses.rationale: Retains harsh animal comparison and repeated destruction as the writer's polemic.
verses.before: But these, like unreasoning animals, creatures of instinct, born to be caught and destroyed, blaspheming about matters of which they are ignorant, will also be destroyed in their destruction,
verses.after: But these people are like unreasoning animals, creatures of instinct born to be caught and destroyed. They slander what they do not understand, and in their destruction they too will be destroyed,
verses.tsw_comparator: But these, like unreasoning animals, creatures of instinct, born to be caught and destroyed, blaspheming about matters of which they are ignorant, will also be destroyed in their destruction,

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned suffering-wrong verb and deceptions reading; keeps social presence.
verses.before: suffering wrong as the wages of their wrongdoing. They count it pleasure to revel in the daytime. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while they feast with you,
verses.after: suffering wrong as the wages of wrongdoing. They regard daytime revelry as pleasure. They are stains and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while they feast with you.
verses.tsw_comparator: suffering wrong as the wages of their wrongdoing. They count it pleasure to revel in the daytime. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their deceptions while they feast with you,

verses.rationale: Keeps the predatory lure, trained hearts and curse idiom with the literal eye image noted.
verses.before: having eyes full of adultery, insatiable for sin. They entice unstable souls. They have hearts trained in greed. Accursed children!
verses.after: Their eyes are full of adultery and never stop sinning. They lure unstable souls and have hearts trained in greed. They are children under a curse!
verses.tsw_comparator: having eyes full of adultery, insatiable for sin. They entice unstable souls. They have hearts trained in greed. Accursed children!

verses.rationale: Preserves the road repetition and the source's Bosor spelling.
verses.before: Forsaking the straight way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved gain from wrongdoing,
verses.after: They have left the straight road and gone astray, following the road of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Forsaking the straight way, they have gone astray. They have followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved gain from wrongdoing,

verses.rationale: Keeps the paradox of a speechless animal speaking and the restraint of the prophet.
verses.before: but was rebuked for his own transgression; a speechless donkey spoke with human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.
verses.after: But he was rebuked for his own lawlessness: a speechless donkey spoke with a human voice and stopped the prophet's madness.
verses.tsw_comparator: but was rebuked for his own transgression; a speechless donkey spoke with human voice and restrained the prophet’s madness.

verses.rationale: Retains both empty water images and the short ending without forever.
verses.before: These are waterless springs and mists driven by a storm. For them the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved.
verses.after: These people are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Deep darkness is reserved for them.
verses.tsw_comparator: These are waterless springs and mists driven by a storm. For them the gloom of utter darkness has been reserved.

verses.rationale: Preserves the vulnerable group's barely emerging escape and the seduction's means.
verses.before: For speaking loud boasts of folly, they entice by sensual passions of the flesh people who are barely escaping from people who live in error.
verses.after: For with grand but empty words, they use fleshly desires and shameless conduct to lure people who are just escaping from those who live in error.
verses.tsw_comparator: For speaking loud boasts of folly, they entice by sensual passions of the flesh those who are barely escaping from those who live in error.

verses.rationale: Keeps the freedom/slavery reversal and its general explanatory maxim.
verses.before: They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person, to that he is enslaved.
verses.after: They promise them freedom while they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person enslaves that person.
verses.tsw_comparator: They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves of corruption. For whatever overcomes a person, to that he is enslaved.

verses.rationale: Retains the conditional return and consequential worsening without resolving the referent beyond they.
verses.before: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.
verses.after: If, after escaping the world's defilements through knowing the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they become entangled in them again and are overcome, their last state is worse than their first.
verses.tsw_comparator: For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

verses.rationale: Preserves the difficult counterfactual and transmitted command.
verses.before: For it would have been better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than after knowing it to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.
verses.after: It would have been better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than to know it and turn back from the holy command handed down to them.
verses.tsw_comparator: For it would have been better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than after knowing it to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

verses.rationale: Keeps both repellent animal proverbs and their distinct actions.
verses.before: What the true proverb says has happened to them: “The dog returns to its own vomit,” and, “The washed sow returns to wallowing in the mud.”
verses.after: What the true proverb says has happened to them: “A dog returns to its own vomit,” and, “A washed sow returns to wallowing in mud.”
verses.tsw_comparator: What the true proverb says has happened to them: “The dog returns to its own vomit,” and, “The washed sow returns to wallowing in the mud.”

verses.rationale: Retains second letter and plural reference to both, without identifying another document.
verses.before: This is now the second letter that I am writing to you, beloved. In both of them I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of reminder,
verses.after: Beloved, this is now the second letter I am writing to you. In both letters I use reminders to awaken your sincere understanding,
verses.tsw_comparator: This is now the second letter that I am writing to you, beloved. In both of them I am stirring up your sincere mind by way of reminder,

verses.rationale: Makes the transmission relation clear while preserving your apostles.
verses.before: that you should remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior through your apostles,
verses.after: so that you remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the command of the Lord and Savior given through your apostles.
verses.tsw_comparator: that you should remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets and the commandment of the Lord and Savior through your apostles,

verses.rationale: Retains the repeated mockery and its moral characterization.
verses.before: knowing this first of all, that scoffers will come in the last days with scoffing, following their own desires,
verses.after: Above all, know this: in the last days scoffers will come with their scoffing, following their own desires
verses.tsw_comparator: knowing this first of all, that scoffers will come in the last days with scoffing, following their own desires,

verses.rationale: Keeps the scoffers' question and their claimed uninterrupted continuity.
verses.before: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, everything continue as they were from the beginning of creation.”
verses.after: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? Ever since our ancestors fell asleep, everything has continued as it was from the beginning of creation.”
verses.tsw_comparator: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of creation.”

verses.rationale: Preserves both water prepositions and deliberate overlooking without adding a cosmology.
verses.before: For they deliberately overlook this fact, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God,
verses.after: They deliberately overlook this: long ago the heavens existed, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by God's word.
verses.tsw_comparator: For they deliberately overlook this fact, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God,

verses.rationale: Leaves the plural these open and keeps the watery destruction.
verses.before: and that by means of these the world that then existed was deluged with water and perished.
verses.after: Through these, the world of that time was flooded with water and destroyed.
verses.tsw_comparator: and that by means of these the world that then existed was deluged with water and perished.

verses.rationale: Retains the contrast, same word and reserved fire.
verses.before: But by the same word the heavens and earth that now exist are stored up for fire, being kept until the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.
verses.after: But by the same word, the present heavens and earth are stored up for fire, kept for the day of judgment and the destruction of ungodly people.
verses.tsw_comparator: But by the same word the heavens and earth that now exist are stored up for fire, being kept until the day of judgment and destruction of the ungodly.

verses.rationale: Preserves both directions of the comparison without turning it into a chronology formula.
verses.before: But do not overlook this one thing, beloved, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.after: But do not overlook this one thing, beloved: with the Lord one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years like one day.
verses.tsw_comparator: But do not overlook this one thing, beloved, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

verses.rationale: Keeps the you reading, contrast of slowness and patience, and any/all scope.
verses.before: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.after: The Lord is not slow about the promise, as some understand slowness. He is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
verses.tsw_comparator: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

verses.rationale: Follows the pinned found/exposed reading rather than substituting burned up; ambiguity is noted.
verses.before: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the elements will be dissolved with fire, and the earth and the works done on it will be exposed.
verses.after: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will pass away with a roar, the elements will be dissolved by fire, and the earth and the works done on it will be exposed.
verses.tsw_comparator: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the elements will be dissolved with fire, and the earth and the works done on it will be exposed.

verses.rationale: Preserves the question connecting cosmic expectation to conduct.
verses.before: Since all these things are thus to be dissolved, what sort of people ought you to be in lives of holiness and godliness,
verses.after: Since all these things are to be dissolved in this way, what sort of people ought you to be in holy conduct and godliness,
verses.tsw_comparator: Since all these things are thus to be dissolved, what sort of people ought you to be in lives of holiness and godliness,

verses.rationale: Keeps hastening alongside waiting and the repeated dissolution without harmonizing the terms.
verses.before: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be set on fire and dissolved, and the elements will melt as they burn!
verses.after: waiting for and hastening the coming of God's day, because of which the heavens will be dissolved in fire and the elements will melt in the heat?
verses.tsw_comparator: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be set on fire and dissolved, and the elements will melt as they burn!

verses.rationale: Retains new creation and personified righteousness dwelling there.
verses.before: But according to his promise we are waiting for new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells.
verses.after: But according to his promise, we await new heavens and a new earth, where righteousness makes its home.
verses.tsw_comparator: But according to his promise we are waiting for new heavens and a new earth in which righteousness dwells.

verses.rationale: Keeps waiting tied to diligence and the reversal of the earlier blemish language.
verses.before: So, beloved, since you are waiting for these, be diligent to be found by him without spot or blemish, and at peace.
verses.after: So, beloved, as you wait for these things, make every effort to be found by him at peace, without stain or blemish.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore, beloved, since you are waiting for these, be diligent to be found by him without spot or blemish, and at peace.

verses.rationale: Preserves the named writer, shared affection and gifted wisdom.
verses.before: And count the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you according to the wisdom given him,
verses.after: Regard our Lord's patience as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you with the wisdom given to him.
verses.tsw_comparator: And count the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote to you according to the wisdom given him,

verses.rationale: Keeps difficulty in the letters explicit and preserves other Scriptures without specifying a canon list.
verses.before: as he does in all his letters when he speaks in them of these matters. There are some things in them that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable twist to their own destruction, as they do the other Scriptures.
verses.after: He speaks of these things in all his letters. Some things in them are hard to understand, and the uninstructed and unstable twist them, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: as he does in all his letters when he speaks in them of these matters. There are some things in them that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable twist to their own destruction, as they do the other Scriptures.

verses.rationale: Preserves prior warning, shared danger and stability imagery.
verses.before: You therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, take care that you are not carried away with the error of lawless people and lose your own stability.
verses.after: You therefore, beloved, already know this. Guard yourselves against being carried away by the error of the lawless and losing your own firm footing.
verses.tsw_comparator: You therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, take care that you are not carried away with the error of lawless people and lose your own stability.

verses.rationale: Retains growth, full title and the unusual day-of-eternity expression.
verses.before: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
verses.after: Instead, grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory, both now and into the day of eternity. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
